احتضنت (form VIII)
# اِحْتَضَنْتُ (iḥtaḍantu) /iħ.ta.dˤan.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِحْتَضَنَ (iḥtaḍana)
# اِحْتَضَنْتَ (iḥtaḍanta) /iħ.ta.dˤan.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِحْتَضَنَ (iḥtaḍana)
# اِحْتَضَنْتِ (iḥtaḍanti) /iħ.ta.dˤan.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِحْتَضَنَ (iḥtaḍana)
# اِحْتَضَنَتْ (iḥtaḍanat) /iħ.ta.dˤa.nat/: third-p
